name: datacamp-learning-builder
description: Use DataCamp as a structured learning source to research topics and build reusable ChatGPT learning workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build reusable learning workflows from DataCamp
interface.longDescription: Search DataCamp courses, chapters, exercises, tutorials, webinars, and code-alongs, then organize the retrieved material into structured reusable learning workflows for ChatGPT. The plugin keeps DataCamp as the live content source instead of copying the catalog into the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Find the best DataCamp material for this topic and build a structured learning workflow from it.
Use DataCamp to research this subject and turn the results into a reusable skill outline.
Build a progressive course plan from relevant DataCamp content.
